offence_note: Impaired causing death and bodily harm, refusing breath sample, assault peace officer
sentence_quote: I conclude on that basis that the overall sentence is excessive to the extent that I find a total sentence of five years to be a fit and appropriate sentence in this circumstance.
note: Five years on death count, others concurrent; prohibition 5 years plus custody term.

offence_note: Kidnapping, robbery, extortion of elderly woman, driving offences, false pretences
sentence_quote: The appellant received a total sentence of fifty-four months (in addition to ten months calculated on a two-for-one basis for time spent in pre-trial custody)
note: Leave granted, appeal dismissed; sentence called lenient.

offence_note: Two counts second degree murder, attempted murder
sentence_quote: I sentence you on the attempted murder of Bradley Martin to life imprisonment. In respect of the second degree murder of Keith Wharton, I sentence you to life imprisonment with parole ineligibility to be fixed at 22 years.
note: Concurrent life sentences, 22 years parole ineligibility each; Metis status recently obtained; surcharge declined.

offence_note: Break and enters and theft substituted for robbery
sentence_quote: It becomes a total sentence of 18 months.
note: Robbery conviction replaced by theft; two convictions acquitted; overall sentence unchanged.

offence_note: Sexual assault of 17-year-old; dangerous offender application
sentence_quote: Accordingly, I sentence Mr. Foulds as a dangerous offender to an indeterminate sentence.
note: Court recommends sex offender program ICPM start soon; non-communication order with complainant.

offence_note: Police officer: unprovoked assault and fabricating evidence
sentence_quote: This was such a grave offence that a sentence of imprisonment was the only appropriate disposition.
note: Jail length not stated; career loss argued but outweighed.

sentence_quote: The appeal as to conviction and sentence is dismissed.

offence_note: Uttering threats and assault with a weapon
sentence_quote: substituted by the sentence recommended in the joint submission, which was 12 months (consisting of 6 months of house arrest and 6 months of curfew), followed by a period of 18 months’ probation.
note: Joint submission restored: 12 months community sentence (6 house arrest, 6 curfew); conditional sentence length ambiguous.

sentence_quote: I would therefore confirm the sentence of five years’ imprisonment.
note: Gladue errors at trial but sentence upheld; Gladue weighed little given seriousness.

sentence_quote: set aside the sentence imposed by the trial judge and impose a sentence of 90 days. I would stay the imposition of the jail term.
note: Crown appeal allowed; 90-day minimum imposed but stayed; probation and prohibition remain.
